Class AbstractGridModel

java.lang.Object
de.schladebeck.fx.grid.model.AbstractGridModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
GridModel
Direct Known Subclasses:
ComputedGridModel, ListGridModel, PagedGridModel, TreeGridModel
public abstract class AbstractGridModel extends Object implements GridModel

Base class for models: listener handling, fire helpers like Swing's AbstractTableModel, and a safe way to change data from any thread.

The grid reads the model on the JavaFX application thread, so the data must only change there. Wrap changes in applyChange(Runnable), which runs them there:

public void put(int row, int column, double value) {    // any thread
    applyChange(() -> {
        values[row][column] = value;
        fireRowsUpdated(row, row);
    });
}

Fire events only inside such changes or on the JavaFX thread; the grid rejects events from other threads.

    • applyChange

      protected final void applyChange(Runnable change)

      Runs a change of the model's data on the JavaFX application thread: right away when called there, otherwise queued. Change the data and fire the matching events inside change.

      • Changes from other threads run in the order they were applied. A change applied on the JavaFX thread runs right away, on the rows as they are on screen, before changes still queued from other threads; so row numbers taken from the grid stay right.
      • Queued changes run in batches of about 8 ms, so input and painting go on while other threads change the model faster than the JavaFX thread can keep up.
      • A queued change that throws is passed to the uncaught exception handler of the thread running it, and the changes after it still run.
      • Before the JavaFX toolkit has started, changes run right away on the calling thread, e.g. to fill a model in main before Application.launch.
      Parameters:
      change - the data change, including the events it fires

    • applySetup

      protected final void applySetup(Runnable change)
      For builder methods that set up columns, names or types: runs right away while no grid listens to the model, so a model can be set up and read back on any thread. Once a grid shows the model, the same as applyChange(Runnable). Changes of the data always use applyChange(Runnable).
      Parameters:
      change - the change, including the events it fires
